qa: No, you can't. This card is only treated as [Ballistamon] for a DigiXros. Related Cards

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: This card is also treated as [Ballistamon] for DigiXros. [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon can't be returned to hands or decks by your opponent's effects and gets +3000 DP. [On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Opponent's Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Blocker＞.
